words.trans: v. 推开、挪到一旁、移开（把重物推到一边）
examples: After shunting it to one side to reveal the manhole cover, he lifted the lid.

words.trans: n.（潜水用的）脚蹼；鱼鳍；鳍状物
examples: Inside was a pile of diving equipment: wetsuits, masks, fins, oxygen tanks.

words.trans: n. 各种各样、一套、各类物品的组合（an assortment of 各种各样的）
examples: An assortment of tubes and dials.

words.trans: adj. 头昏眼花的、昏沉的；神志不清、脚步不稳（常因疲劳、撞击、药物）
examples: He wished the groggy feeling in his head would go.

words.trans: n. 粥、燕麦粥
examples: Thinking would feel like swimming through porridge.

words.trans: n. 记忆空白、断片（可数）。have a blank 脑子一片空白；My mind went blank 脑子突然一片空白/断片（最常用）；My mind was a blank 脑海一片空白；draw a blank 苦想却想不起来、一无所获
examples: For a moment he had a blank and could not even remember what time of year it was.

words.trans: 一年当中的时节/季节（是夏天？秋天？几月份？）
examples: He could not even remember what time of year it was.

words.trans: n. 凹陷处、坑洼、洼地；（情绪）抑郁；（经济）萧条
examples: The manhole cover was in a slight depression in the centre of the floor.

words.trans: n.（洗手池、浴缸的）下水孔、排水口
examples: Like a plughole at the bottom of a sink.

words.trans: n. 虚无、空无一物；茫茫黑暗、不存在
examples: The beam was swallowed up by a black hole that disappeared into nothingness.

words.trans: n.（梯子的）横档、梯级（复数 rungs）
examples: The torchlight picked out a series of metal rungs.

words.trans: v. 翻找、搜寻（在一堆东西里扒来扒去地找）。rummage in/through 翻找
examples: He rummaged in the box and found a spanner.

words.trans: （光线）映照出、照见、清晰显现出（从暗背景里挑亮某物）
examples: The torchlight picked out its spinning form for a few seconds.

words.trans: 数不尽、数不胜数（多到数不清）
examples: A series of metal rungs that descended beyond counting.

words.trans: adj. 完全的、彻底的、十足的（加强语气，utter blackness 一片漆黑、彻底的黑暗）
examples: The rungs faded into utter blackness.

words.trans: n. 竖井、深井通道（垂直向下的深井；也指杆、柄、光束）
examples: He tossed the spanner into the shaft.

words.trans: 此义 ≠ 当……的时候（时间）。这里的 when 是让步/对比用法，译“既然；连……都（这样），那……”，引出一个较弱的参照事例来加强反问。句式：When A is already true, how can B happen?（连A都受不了，B更不可能做到）
examples: When even an underground car park made him feel a silent scream rising in his chest, how could he climb down that ladder?

words.trans: n. 肠、肠道（复数 intestines 更常用）；比喻狭长蜿蜒的通道
examples: Into that great intestine that wound through the earth.

words.trans: adj. 令人恶心的、使人反胃的
examples: The bus with its nauseating smell.

words.trans: 急转弯、发卡弯（像发卡 hairpin 一样 U 型的山路弯道）
examples: They growled their way up the hairpin bends towards the slate mines.

words.trans: n.（英式口语，复数）橡胶雨靴、高筒防水胶靴（= Wellington boots）
examples: Everyone put their wellies on.

words.trans: 分发（多份，发给一群人）。hand sth out / hand out sth
examples: Mr Woodburn handed out clipboards and worksheets.

words.trans: 固定短语：动身、出发、启程（= set out）
examples: They set off up a winding gravel track.

words.trans: （英式，乡村/矿区）碎石压出的简易小路，没铺柏油，走起来沙沙的，车子行人都能走
examples: They set off up a winding gravel track.

words.trans: n. 矿渣堆、废渣堆——开采矿石后剩下的废料堆成的小山
examples: Towering slag heaps of broken slate.

words.trans: adj. 高耸的、矗立的、堆得像小山一样（高耸入云或高大得压倒人）
examples: Between towering slag heaps of broken slate.

words.trans: 高亮反光防水工作服（矿工穿的那种荧光雨衣）。hi-vis = high-visibility 高可视度的、荧光醒目
examples: Some men dressed like miners, all hi-vis waterproofs and helmets.

words.trans: v.（faffing）瞎忙活、磨磨蹭蹭、折腾半天，花很多时间在琐碎小事上手忙脚乱，不是认真干活。偏“瞎忙活、折腾”，贬义不重
examples: After the muttering and faffing of getting everyone kitted out had died down.

words.trans: （吵闹声、风、火等）慢慢平息、安静下来、减弱消失
examples: The muttering and faffing had died down.

words.trans: 配齐全套装备（kit out 给……配备齐装备，be kitted out 装备齐全）
examples: Getting everyone kitted out had died down.

words.trans: adj. 三义辨析：① 十足的、纯粹的、完全的（修饰抽象名词 sheer grit/luck/madness/nonsense——强调完完全全就是这个、没掺别的）；② 近乎垂直、陡峭的（修饰悬崖/岩壁/落差 sheer drop/cliff，直直往下几乎无坡度）；③（织物）极薄、透明的（sheer silk 薄如蝉翼）。判断技巧：后接抽象品质→纯粹十足；后接山崖落差→陡峭垂直；后接布料→薄透
examples: Praised the sheer grit of the miners.

words.trans: 纯粹靠意志力硬扛下来的顽强、十足的坚韧。grit 抽象义：毅力、坚韧不拔的勇气、不畏艰难的意志
examples: Mr Woodburn praised the sheer grit of the miners.

words.trans: 开凿出、开辟出来（carved out tunnels 在岩层中开凿出隧道）
examples: The miners who had carved out these tunnels beneath millions of tonnes of earth.

words.word: with every fibre of his being
words.trans: 固定文学习语。fibre（英式，美式 fiber）：字面“他整个生命里的每一根纤维”；实际含义：发自灵魂深处、全心全意、拼尽全部身心（去盼望）。being 此处=人的全部身心、生命本体
examples: Tom wished with every fibre of his being that the miners hadn't bothered.
words.key: with every fibre of one's being

words.trans: n.（医学）癫痫发作、惊厥（不是“抓住”）。have a seizure 突发癫痫
examples: That Mr Woodburn would have a seizure and need urgent medical attention.

words.trans: n. 保温壶、扁保温瓶（装咖啡/茶随身带的）
examples: The bus driver remained with a flask of coffee and a bag of doughnuts.

words.trans: v.（waddling）摇摇摆摆地走（像鸭子那样左右晃着走）
examples: Come waddling up the track with a message.

words.trans: 排成一队、挨个穿过（洞口/门）。file 作动词“鱼贯而行”
examples: They had all filed through the entrance.

words.trans: 一群互相推挤的人（pack 一群，shoving 推搡的）
examples: He found himself in the middle of a pack of shoving bodies.

words.trans: v. 欢呼大喊、嗬嗬地叫嚷（hoo-hooing 大声喊叫以听回声）
examples: All hoo-hooing to hear the echoes.

words.trans: adj. 深及脚踝的（water ankle-deep 水深到脚踝）
examples: Ankle-deep in water, stooping and stumbling through the tunnel.

words.trans: adj. 湿冷黏腻的（摸上去潮湿、发凉、有点黏手）
examples: Stumbling through the clammy tunnel.

words.trans: adj. 含沙粒的、沙沙的；引申（形容人）坚韧顽强的；形容故事/电影“写实粗粝的、不美化的”——a gritty drama 一部写实沉重、不加美化的现实题材剧
examples: The millions of tonnes of rock those gritty miners had put between him and the sky.

words.trans: n. 喋喋不休的闲聊、絮絮叨叨的废话（没什么要紧内容、不停说的话）
examples: He was aware of Snakey and his friends behind him by their constant prattle.

words.trans: 一缕狭长的日光（slit 狭缝）
examples: A slit of daylight fell on the puddled water.

words.trans: n. 象征、标记、信物（a token of another world 另一个世界的象征/征兆；keep sth as a token of love 留作爱的信物）
examples: A slit of daylight fell on the puddled water like a token of another world.

words.trans: n. 大洞穴、巨洞（比 cave 更强调巨大、空旷，多指岩石里天然或开采形成的大洞室）
examples: The tunnel opened up into a cavern.

words.trans: adj. 安静下来的、压低声音的（hushed clump 寂静的人群；hushed tones 压低的语调）
examples: The class had assembled into a hushed clump.

words.trans: n. 一团、一簇；此处指挤成一堆的人群（a clump of trees 一簇树）
examples: Assembled into a hushed clump.

words.trans: n. 太阳穴（头两侧、眼睛后方那块软的部位，常用复数 temples）；另义“庙宇”
examples: Tom pressed his hands on to his temples.

words.trans: v. 发誓、郑重许诺（vowing to do sth 发誓要做某事）；n. 誓言
examples: Telling himself it would soon be over and vowing to savour every breath.

words.trans: v. 细细品味、好好享受（英式拼写；美式 savor）
examples: Vowing to savour every breath once he was out.

words.trans: v. 倒抽一口气、大口喘气（因惊讶、疼痛、缺氧）
examples: Everyone was gasping about a sheer drop.

words.trans: 垂直的陡崖、直上直下的深坑（没有斜坡、近乎垂直的落差）
examples: A sheer drop, where the tunnel wall had fallen away into emptiness.

words.trans: n. 耽搁、停顿（队伍走不动、堵在那里；英式常用，美式 traffic jam）
examples: Further on there was another hold-up.

words.trans: 絮絮叨叨、单调乏味地长篇大论（像嗡嗡声一样单调地讲个不停）
examples: Mr Woodburn was droning on about sedimentary rock.

words.trans: adj. 沉积的。sedimentary rock 沉积岩
examples: He was droning on about sedimentary rock.

words.trans: 离……保持距离、站远一点、不要靠上去（常作警告用语，英式常见，警示危险）。Stand clear of the edge 离边缘远点
examples: One of the hi-vis men was telling them to stand clear.

words.trans: 理解、领会、消化（信息）（= absorb, comprehend）
examples: Tom could not take in what was being said.

words.trans: n. 狗窝、犬舍（no bigger than the entrance to a dog kennel 只有狗窝入口那么大）
examples: A hole no bigger than the entrance to a dog kennel.

words.word: get on one's hands and knees
words.trans: 手脚着地、四肢趴在地上（跪爬）
examples: Everyone was lining up to get on their hands and knees and squeeze through.
words.key: get on one's hands and knees

words.trans: v. 窃笑、嗤笑、偷偷坏笑（英式，美式常拼 snicker）。snigger about sth 拿某事取笑、偷偷笑这件事
examples: Someone was sniggering about Aiden Smith's belly getting stuck.

words.trans: n. 软木瓶塞（stuck like a cork in a bottle 像瓶塞卡在瓶口一样卡住）
examples: His belly getting stuck like a cork in a bottle.

words.trans: n. 恼火、极其不耐烦（genuine exasperation 真的不耐烦了）
examples: Snakey was hissing behind him with genuine exasperation.

words.trans: adv. 牢牢地、紧紧地、稳固地（stuck fast 卡得死死的；hold fast 抓紧）。⚠️ 此处不是“快”
examples: He wanted to run but his legs were stuck fast.

words.trans: v. 用带子捆扎、绑牢（strap...to... 把……绑在……上）；n. 带子、皮带、布带
examples: He wanted to strap himself to a stick of dynamite.

words.trans: 一根炸药棒。dynamite 甘油炸药、达纳炸药（固体长条状）。引申口语 It is dynamite! = 这东西超棒、很劲爆（非正式）
examples: Strap himself to a stick of dynamite and blast through the mountain.

words.trans: （空气）变得稀薄（高海拔氧气变少）
examples: Up and away until the air grew thin.

words.trans: adj. 耀眼的、璀璨夺目的、令人目眩的
examples: His lake, a dazzling silver ribbon, stretching into the sun.

words.trans: adj. 鼻涕满脸的（英式口语，带侮辱性，骂小孩）
examples: You useless, snot-faced baby.

words.trans: n.（矿山）巷道、水平坑道（矿场专业词）；另义“画廊、看台”
examples: He would wait with him in the gallery.

words.trans: n. 一闪而过的微光（a glint of triumph 一闪而过的得意）；v. 闪烁
examples: He caught a glint of triumph in his eye.

words.trans: v. 得意的假笑、沾沾自喜的坏笑（不是开怀大笑，带优越感）；n. 假笑、坏笑
examples: Tom tried to push past him, but Snakey was in the way, smirking.

words.trans: 固定句型：脚被某物绊住
examples: Tom lost his balance, caught his foot on a rock.

words.trans: 恢复知觉、醒过来（从昏迷/晕厥中醒来）= come to（英式）
examples: He had come round in the air ambulance.

words.trans: 空中救护、救援直升机（医疗救援直升机）
examples: He had come round in the air ambulance.

words.trans: n. 担架
examples: His whole body was bound tight in a stretcher.

words.trans: n. 剧痛、撕心裂肺的疼痛（in agony 疼得要命）
examples: His leg was in agony.

words.trans: v. 奔流、涌动、快速穿行。course through sth：（液体/力量/感觉）在里面奔流、穿行、涌动
examples: Blood coursed through his veins.

words.trans: 和……同节奏、合拍、同步
examples: The rotor blades beat in rhythm with his heart.

words.trans: n. 懦弱、胆怯（名词；coward 懦夫）
examples: Ready to punish him with the fact of his own cowardice.

words.word: longing for it to be over
words.trans: 迫切盼望这一切快点结束（long for 渴望、盼望）
examples: He sat on the box, waiting to be found, longing for it to be over.
